title: POSSUM COUNTY FAIR
heading: LAST CALL
ON THE MIDWAY
intro: SET CONCESSION POWER AND PATCH THE BACKSTAGE PA.

stations.label: SET CONCESSION BREAKER
stations.message: CONCESSION LIVE. NORTH GATE IS OPEN.

stations.label: PATCH THE BACKSTAGE PA
stations.message: PA PATCHED. TAKE THE SERVICE CUT BACK TO THE MIDWAY.

stations.label: CUT THE PRIZE BROADCAST
stations.message: RUDY RACKET! GET BEHIND THE PRIZE STALLS.

stations.label: RING THE MIDWAY BELL
stations.message: SHOW BELL RUNG. THE PRIZE PAVILION IS OPEN.

notes: BESSIE'S TAG / FOUND UNDER THE PRIZE RIBBONS. SENT TO BLACKWATER WITH THE CRATES.

mill-leaky-standpipe: STANDPIPE SHUDDERS. STEP OFF THE GRATE.
quarry-cut-leak: COPPER JOINT WHISTLES. GIVE IT ROOM.
